title: The 6 Best Gaming Monitors 2026
metaDescription: Our 6 picks for gaming monitors 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at gaming monitors 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: LG 27GP850-B (27" 1440p 165Hz)
products.blurb: Key specs: 27-inch IPS panel, 1440p, 165Hz, 1ms GtG response time, 98% DCI-P3 color gamut.
strengths: IPS panel provides wide viewing angles and accurate color, competitors at this price use VA
98% DCI-P3 covers creative and gaming use without separate color modes
USB-C 90W charges a MacBook or gaming laptop while gaming
1440p at 27 inches is the best pixel density for gaming without GPU overhead of 4K
limitations: IPS glow visible in dark scenes at wide viewing angles
No built-in USB hub, one USB-C port only
Stand is height-adjustable but not swivel in all positions
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Samsung Odyssey G7 (28" 4K 144Hz)
products.blurb: Key specs: 28-inch IPS panel, 4K, 144Hz, DisplayHDR 400 certification, G-Sync Compatible, FreeSync Premium Pro.
strengths: 4K at 144Hz with HDMI 2.1, works with PS5 and Xbox Series X at full spec
HDMI 2.1 passes through 4K/120Hz to consoles without adapters
IPS panel color accuracy for content creation alongside gaming
28 inches at 4K is a sharp pixel density without requiring font scaling
limitations: Requires RTX 4080/4090 or RX 7900 XTX to run AAA titles at 4K/144fps
DisplayHDR 400 has limited HDR impact, peak brightness is insufficient for HDR pop

products.name: AOC Q27G3XMN (27" VA 180Hz)
products.blurb: Key specs: 27-inch VA panel, 1440p, 180Hz, Rapid VA technology, 3000:1 contrast ratio.
strengths: Rapid VA technology significantly reduces the ghosting that plagues standard VA panels
3000:1 contrast ratio produces deep blacks in dark scenes, better than IPS at similar price
VA panel blacks are visibly better in cinematic gaming compared to IPS
limitations: Still some ghosting with fast motion despite Rapid VA improvement
Color at wide viewing angles is worse than IPS, noticeable for multiple viewers
MPRT measurement requires strobing, which reduces brightness
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: ASUS TUF Gaming VG27AQ1A 27" 1440p 170Hz Monitor
strengths: Sharp 1440p on a 27-inch IPS panel
Up to 170Hz refresh
ELMB reduces motion blur
G-SYNC Compatible with a 3-year warranty
limitations: Stand lacks swivel on some versions

products.name: MSI MAG 274QRF QD E2 27" 1440p 180Hz Monitor
strengths: 180Hz QHD refresh
Quantum dot wide color
1ms response
Adaptive-Sync support
limitations: Variant names are confusing; check the model

products.name: Alienware AW2725DF 27" QD-OLED 360Hz Gaming Monitor
strengths: 360Hz refresh with near-instant OLED pixel response
Per-pixel contrast and deep blacks
Wide DCI-P3 color coverage (Dell spec)
3-year warranty that Dell says covers burn-in
limitations: OLED needs care with static elements despite burn-in coverage
Glossy-style coating reflects in bright rooms

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
